description: SSH-model identity: accept a peer's key on first contact, pin it, alert on change. No infrastructure needed. DEFAULT auth mechanism for all non-Tailscale transports. identify_caller extracts identity from the pinned key. Contacts store the peer's public key fingerprint. On first connect, the fingerprint is recorded; on subsequent connects, mismatches trigger a warning (like SSH's REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED). Pairs with any transport that exposes a stable public key (self-signed TLS cert, DID:key, etc.). Other auth mechanisms (ACME, DANE, PKIX) layer on top as optional hardening. Contacts can later be upgraded to DID-backed identity when cross-system interop is needed.
title: Auth mechanism: TOFU (trust on first use)
